selection_reason: CCPD2019 contains the official base and adverse-condition subsets plus official splits; CCPD2020 is a smaller green-plate supplemental artifact, not a substitute for the full T3-D/T3-O distribution-shift benchmark.

publisher.governing_download_license: CC BY 4.0 mirror terms plus attribution; internal evaluation only under this contract

privacy_disposition.human_display_allowed: only to an authorized evaluator when necessary for annotation/error review; never in team-lead demo or generated reports
privacy_disposition.derived_output_policy: metrics, aggregate error classes and non-reversible hashes only; no plate strings, crops, filenames containing encoded plate text or contextual thumbnails
privacy_disposition.retention: outside Git under C:\NexusAI-Evaluation; deletion requires an explicit operator action

artifacts.benchmark_role: primary independent real T3-D detector and T3-O OCR distribution-shift evidence
artifacts.contents: CCPD-Base plus DB, Blur, FN, Rotate, Tilt and Challenge subsets; use official repository splits

artifacts.benchmark_role: supplemental real green-plate T3-D/T3-O evidence only

acceptance_after_download: exact byte size and publisher MD5 pass
no path traversal, symlink or unexpected executable members
official split files are pinned and copied as hashes, not mutated
filename annotations parse with no unreviewed record drops
a sealed evaluation partition is established before model comparison
all outputs follow the privacy disposition
limitations: Chinese plates and parking imagery are international T3 evidence, not Pakistan operational agreement.
A pass does not remove the Pakistan-format limitation and does not satisfy T4.
No candidate may be tuned on a partition later reported as holdout.
